text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki takes 1st—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaah--!)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Phew, haah... alright...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wha, what is that!
What is that speed... is that Fuji Kiseki!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Right! Wow, even though she's just running,
she's so captivating I couldn't take my eyes off her!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki's run in the Satsuki Sho
filled the entire venue with excitement and fervor!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you!
Your cheers became the wind beneath my wings!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
However, the dream isn't over yet!
Please look forward to the upcoming Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (—Having said that, though...)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, you see,
...there's something on my mind!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There's something I need to confirm.
Would it be alright if I did some self-training tonight?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"You said you felt something off in your leg after the Satsuki Sho finish line,
right? It doesn't sound like an injury, though, does it?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's not an injury. I wanted to talk to you about
whether there's a wall standing in my way there.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"A wall, you say? In other words...
are we talking about distance aptitude?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah, pretty much. You're quick on the uptake as always!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I've had a feeling for a while now.
That my aptitudes might be leaning more toward being a miler."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon, with your help, I believe we could gather some highly accurate data to make decisions.
Would you be willing to cooperate?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... You know, in all things,
I believe the principle of equivalent exchange is vital.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: In short—if you'd be willing to test out my new medicine, I'd gladly assist you. What do you say?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...!
Fine, I'll drink it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Alright! As expected, you're quick to catch on!
Well then, let us proceed to the experiment at once—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Before that, a few points of caution.
Even if you run the exact same time,
the physical toll during a real race is different from training."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Take this purely as a reference point.
—And with that said, first up is 2,400 meters!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Ngh, the fourth corner curve—
I'll start my spurt right here...!)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Ngh...! Keep... going...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ho! I see, I see!
One really shouldn't underestimate intuition, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: How was it, Tachyon?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I've obtained some intriguing results!
Let us go through this systematically from the beginning, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
First, have you ever heard the terms
"aerobic energy" and "anaerobic energy"?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Of course! We learned about it in class, too.
To put it simply—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Cruising speed during a race—in other words,
what you use to maintain your pace—
is aerobic energy, and—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So anaerobic energy is what you need when you're
accelerating, like right after the start or before the finish?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Exactly!
During a race, we run while producing and consuming these two types of energy!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
There's no doubt that both are vital sources
of energy, but the anaerobic side is the one
where proper management becomes especially crucial.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's essential during the decisive moments of a race, but there's only so much of it.
Once it runs out, exhaustion takes over and your legs come to a halt.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In short, the key is how well you can conserve
your anaerobic energy until the final stretch, but—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, when aerobic energy alone
can no longer maintain mid-race pacing,
anaerobic energy steps in to compensate.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Umm, so that means...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The faster the pace and the longer the distance,
the more anaerobic energy is depleted along the way...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Roughly speaking, that's about it!
And as for your run just now—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Her form faltered past the 2000m mark,
and she visibly struggled to maintain her pace!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
She was constantly burning through her anaerobic energy
to maintain that pace, so she must have been running on empty.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: And amidst all that, on the final stretch, just before the goal—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Ngh...! Keep... going...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Having exhausted your anaerobic energy,
your legs can no longer process lactic acid—
you've completely hit a wall...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Right when we expected you to surge ahead another gear with your sharp late burst, your greatest weapon—you stalled out."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"—Looking strictly at the results of this test,
it's true that your aptitudes don't seem suited
for running long distances."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
While she possesses legs and brilliant talent
that convert anaerobic energy into explosive acceleration—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to the ability to transport oxygen to muscles,
which impacts aerobic energy production,
it seems you are about average.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
If you say so, then it must be true.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for your help, Tachyon.
With this, we can finally move on to the next step!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind at all. More importantly, a promise is a promise!
I need you to taste-test this, Fuji-kun!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Is that really safe to drink?
The color looks a bit..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Don't fret over trivial things.
Come on, come on, down it in one go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Fuji Kiseki
paid a visit to the Trainer's Office.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, I asked Tachyon for help
and had her analyze my aptitudes. And well—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was explained to me thoroughly that at medium distance and above, the longer the race gets, the harder it is to win.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: In other words, both the Nippon Derby and the Kikuka Sho look like they'll be even tougher races than expected.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"So, there's something about our future
that I'd like to discuss with you again."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neither the Nippon Derby nor the Kikuka Sho are so forgiving
that you can win at a distance you're unsuited for.
In other words—
choice_data_list: You want to give up on achieving the Triple Crown...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it.
It's the exact opposite!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because of the wall of distance aptitude that I have
two dramatic paths I can challenge!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The bar is set higher than ever, which is precisely why
taking on the Triple Crown route is so thrilling—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Or you could take a huge turn and pour all your talent into conquering the top of the mile division—those two paths!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "...I'm sorry for making a suggestion like this when you had already planned my training around the Triple Crown route."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Faced with the wall of distance aptitude, I thought about
what I could do with my own legs in my own way.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Achieving the Triple Crown is a tremendous honor. Winning this is beyond a doubt the ultimate spectacle!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why I wanted to seize glory on that grand stage,
and achieve a catharsis that would electrify everyone's heart."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: “However, if these legs are suited for the mile, then that changes the conversation.”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
On the mile route, I can put on a show
that maximizes the true power of these legs!
That possibility was born.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...And well, this all came out of nowhere, but
what do you think? Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Which one should I truly choose?
...In the end, I couldn't reach an answer that day.
